# Repo Creator 1.4.3 — UI Consistency & Polish

Version 1.4.3 refines Repo Creator's layouts, controls and previews while preserving its familiar appearance.

### What's New

- **More balanced layouts** — Improved navigation, workspace proportions and spacing across project creation, projects, presets and settings.
- **Clearer interactions** — Consistent control sizing, icon alignment, hover and keyboard focus states, with subtle transitions that respect reduced motion.
- **Better file previews** — More readable generated content and an expanded preview dialog, including in smaller windows.
- **Refined configuration screens** — Clearer expandable sections, more compact AI settings, wrapping technology selections and subtler scrollbars.
- **Readable update notes** — Formatted Markdown release notes with safely handled links, plus an application version display that stays consistent with Settings.

### Installation

Download the Windows x64 or matching macOS package under **Assets**. See `SHA256SUMS.txt` for download checksums.

Installed v1.4.1 and v1.4.2 copies can receive this beta through **Settings → Updates → Beta** after publication. Users of v1.4.0 and earlier must upgrade manually. Windows portable ZIP copies require manual replacement; extract the entire archive before opening the app. On macOS, move the application out of the DMG before using updates.

**Known limitations:**

- Windows installers remain unsigned at the operating-system level. Cryptographic updater signatures do not provide operating-system code signing.
- macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized; physical Mac launch and installation remain unverified.
- End-to-end update installation and restart remain unverified for this release.

### Feedback

Found a bug or have a suggestion? [Open an issue](https://github.com/DefinitivedCode/RepoCreator/issues).
